name: Study of the Elements: Rock
summary: Lotwil Veriatus praises you as abler than all of Lotwil's apprentices combined, and wants the next step of the tests. This time the need is three large stone slabs, pieces best found on rock elementals.

sections.title: Bigger Pieces
sections.body: The next parts of Lotwil Veriatus's work need more strength. Rock elementals have larger, sturdier bodies, so they are likelier to carry pieces big enough for the tests. Lotwil points you further west, or southeast along the edges of the mountains, and has you gather three large stone slabs. Lotwil needs a while to test the smaller pieces you brought before.

sections.title: Lotwil's Hopes
sections.body: Lotwil's spells acted on the smaller pieces just as predicted. If the next experiment goes as well as foreseen, the elementals under Lotwil's control would put anything summoned before to shame.

faq.q: Who sends you after the large slabs?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus, who is working in the Badlands.
The earlier Study of the Elements: Rock, in which you brought Lotwil small stone shards.

faq.q: Where does Lotwil say to find the rock elementals?
faq.answer: Further west of Lotwil, or southeast along the edges of the mountains.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil need larger stone slabs?
faq.answer: Lotwil needs larger pieces for the next tests. Rock elementals have bigger, stronger bodies, so their pieces are large enough.
